baseline.source: v1.1.8's closing full gate, run alone on the owner's answer (DL-229), meeting every line: 50 games of 20 years in 8 processes, the replay kept; the same games as v1.1.7's closing gate (5dbfdaf4…, DL-214), v1.1.8 changing no play; moved from v1.1.6's closing full gate (bce997d2…, DL-205)

run.source: v1.1.5's Gate sweeps, S3 to S13, each 50 games of 20 years (DL-177 to DL-184); the gate profile (DL-186 item 13)

refusals.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): the policy chooses only what the rules accept, so a refusal is a bug; 0 at v1.1.8's closing full gate (DL-229)

invalid.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): a game the validator refuses; 0 at every close; read only when validated after every advance, which a Gate run is not (v1.1.8's closing full gate (DL-229) was not)

stopped.source: M6-S3's harness assertion (DL-59, DL-69): no hero.transferred names the player's Guild; 0 at v1.1.8's closing full gate (DL-229)

unfinished.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): every game ends or plays to its last Turn; 50 of 50 at v1.1.8's closing full gate (DL-229)

roundTrips.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): every last save loads and serialises back identically; 50 of 50 at v1.1.8's closing full gate (DL-229)

replay.source: M2-S12 (DL-34), since v1.1.6-S3 (DL-189) one seed played once more, alone, its last save's length and fingerprint compared with those its shard recorded: two processes; seed-0001 identical at v1.1.8's closing full gate (DL-229), 142,008,748 characters

saveGzipped.source: the owner's answer (DL-188): "stay under 30mb", the mean over the run's games, not every save, measured gzipped as the page keeps it (DL-67, DL-186 item 21, data-model §7); no guard on the uncompressed size, which the report prints; v1.1.8's closing full gate (DL-229): mean 17.51 MiB, max 20.64 MiB gzipped, as v1.1.7's (DL-214)

copyShare.source: the owner's answer (DL-203): "Mean ≤ baseline +25%", restated by the owner as the copy's share of a Turn (DL-206 item 17, DL-205's finding that the copy's milliseconds follow the machine's load): the mean time of the per-Turn copy (copyWorld, ADR-0011) over the run, timed as each year ended, over the mean time of advance, may grow at most 25% over its baseline share without a DL entry; the baseline measured at v1.1.9's closing full gate (harness/reports/v1.1.9-gate-2026-10-10.md): copy mean 1.438 ms over 1,000 copies, advance mean 3.688 ms, share 0.390, at most 0.4875, anchored there by the owner (DL-252), since advance is 34% faster by design (the Best Party module, DL-237) and copyWorld unchanged

noOneFalls.source: v1.1.4-S5 (DL-156): every chance within 2 points of the resolver's rate with no one falling; held at v1.1.6's close, the widest 1.18 points (DL-205, harness/reports/m9-estimate-2026-10-06), as at v1.1.5's re-close (DL-185)

moraleInQuest.source: v1.1.5-S7 (DL-173, the owner's answer): the Quest's bands and success within 3 points with Morale's consequences in; held at v1.1.6's close, the widest 1.61 points (DL-205, harness/reports/m9-estimate-2026-10-06), as at v1.1.5's re-close (DL-185)
